svg.title: The Intikhab Times: front page
svg.desc: A newspaper front page about Intikhab Azam's open-source work. Lead story: Microsoft edits a Teams page and fairfax catches it the same day. Also: blueprint-runtime reproduces 71 of 79 real Make.com runs, pgvector-cpu-check finds 3 build bugs in 13 Postgres images, Open Jev loses on accuracy and wins on calibration, and agentic RAG costs 2.5 times more per correct answer.
